posts.text:
Nearly 90% y/y growth for the world's biggest car exporter is a bit crazy.

A stat I just dug up. From 1970 to 1980 Japan's auto exports increased from 1m cars to 4.5m cars, so +3.5m over ten years. China's car exports are poised to jump 3.5m in 2026 alone!
